title: Infinitive purpose
subtitle: Read a purpose without adding an English subject too quickly.
overview: An infinitive can express the aim of an action, especially after verbs of going, sending, or readiness.
Locate its controller: often the subject of the main verb supplies the understood subject of the infinitive.

items.en: He went out from there to teach them.

items.grc: ἦλθεν γὰρ ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου σῶσαι τὸ ἀπολωλός.
items.en: For the Son of Man came to save what was lost.
